title.en: Change a client's code, client cards at a glance, and a new overview
title.ar: تغيير رمز العميل، وبطاقات عملاء أوضح، ونظرة عامة جديدة

notes.en: Each client card shows four tiles: projects, access records, servers and systems, each with its count.
notes.ar: تعرض كل بطاقة عميل أربع مربعات: المشاريع وسجلات الوصول والخوادم والأنظمة، ولكل منها عددها.

notes.en: The card reads fully in Arabic, and a type with nothing recorded is shown faded.
notes.ar: تظهر البطاقة بالعربية بالكامل، ويظهر النوع الذي لا يحتوي على سجلات بلون باهت.

notes.en: A client's company code can now be changed from its Overview tab, with a confirm and an undo. Nothing loses its client.
notes.ar: يمكن الآن تغيير رمز شركة العميل من تبويب نظرة عامة، مع تأكيد وإمكانية التراجع. لا يفقد أي سجل ارتباطه بالعميل.

notes.en: The client Overview is redesigned, with recent activity, items needing attention and related knowledge items.
notes.ar: أُعيد تصميم نظرة عامة للعميل، مع النشاط الأخير والعناصر التي تحتاج إلى انتباه وعناصر المعرفة ذات الصلة.

notes.en: The Workspace dashboard is clearer: a custom month range with back and next buttons, one row of tiles, and over time shown as a line.
notes.ar: أصبحت لوحة مساحة العمل أوضح: نطاق أشهر مخصص مع زرّي السابق والتالي، وصف واحد من المربعات، والوقت الإضافي يظهر كخط.

notes.en: The account row in the sidebar opens a menu with Settings, View & Comfort and Log Out.
notes.ar: يفتح صف الحساب في القائمة الجانبية قائمة تضم الإعدادات والعرض والراحة وتسجيل الخروج.

notes.en: Company Documents shows each file as one tidy chip with its type, size and upload date.
notes.ar: تعرض مستندات الشركة كل ملف كبطاقة واحدة مرتبة تضم نوعه وحجمه وتاريخ رفعه.

technical: Each tile is its own icon, number and label, so labels translate separately and counts stay in place in right-to-left text.
changeClientCode is the only path that changes a code; renameClient takes names only.
Task counts translate as one phrase; a misplaced translation rule above the i18n file header was removed.

title.en: A clearer guide, and release notes in the app
title.ar: دليل أوضح، وملاحظات الإصدار داخل التطبيق

notes.en: “How This App Thinks” is redesigned: the diagram reads correctly in Arabic, the steps are up to date, and a new “Where everything lives” section opens any page.
notes.ar: أُعيد تصميم «كيف يعمل هذا التطبيق»: المخطط يُقرأ بشكل صحيح بالعربية، والخطوات محدّثة، وقسم جديد «أين تجد كل شيء» يفتح أي صفحة.

notes.en: Settings → General shows “What’s New”: the installed version and what changed in it, in English and Arabic.
notes.ar: تعرض الإعدادات ← عام قسم «ما الجديد»: الإصدار المثبت وما تغيّر فيه بالعربية والإنجليزية.

notes.en: A small signature at the bottom of the sidebar: “Made with love from Darsh”.
notes.ar: توقيع صغير أسفل القائمة الجانبية: «صنع بحب من درش».

technical: Release notes live in release-notes.json (committed, bilingual); test/release-notes-smoke.js requires an entry for the package version.

title.en: Databases on servers, RDP/PAM access, and an environment per database
title.ar: قواعد البيانات على الخوادم، والوصول عبر RDP/PAM، وبيئة لكل قاعدة بيانات

notes.en: Record the databases on each server: name, engine, version, port, login and connection string. Add one with “Add Database” next to “Add Server”, then pick its server.
notes.ar: سجّل قواعد البيانات على كل خادم: الاسم والمحرك والإصدار والمنفذ وبيانات الدخول وسلسلة الاتصال. أضفها من زر «إضافة قاعدة بيانات» بجانب «إضافة خادم» ثم اختر الخادم.

notes.en: A server card lists its databases only when it has some, and a database can move to another server of the same client.
notes.ar: تعرض بطاقة الخادم قواعد بياناته فقط عند وجودها، ويمكن نقل قاعدة البيانات إلى خادم آخر لنفس العميل.

notes.en: Each server is reached by RDP or PAM; a PAM server hides its username and password.
notes.ar: لكل خادم طريقة وصول: RDP أو PAM، ويُخفي خادم PAM اسم المستخدم وكلمة المرور.

notes.en: Each database is marked Production or UAT on its own, apart from its server.
notes.ar: تُحدَّد بيئة كل قاعدة بيانات (الإنتاج أو اختبار القبول) بشكل مستقل عن خادمها.

notes.en: The auth connection form is simpler: no expiry date or credential location, and notes are always shown.
notes.ar: نموذج اتصال المصادقة أبسط: بلا تاريخ انتهاء أو موقع بيانات الدخول، والملاحظات ظاهرة دائماً.

notes.en: Better Arabic: server names translate part by part, and URL reads “الرابط”.
notes.ar: تحسين العربية: تُترجم أجزاء اسم الخادم كلٌّ على حدة، وتظهر URL باسم «الرابط».

technical: Migration 071: client_databases revived with server_id (ON DELETE CASCADE) and an encrypted connection_string; Quick Find kind client-database.
Migration 073: client_databases.environment (PRODUCTION | TEST), backfilled from each database's server.

title.en: Track each step as done or not yet, and export files as a ZIP

notes.en: Each stage is Done or Not done yet, picked with two clear buttons; marking the current stage not done moves the status back to the last done step.
The list and the Excel show the waiting step: status, done or not, person and notes.
Export menu: Excel only, or a ZIP with the Excel plus the newest version's files, one folder per client, named in the app language.

title.en: Add a pull-cord lamp to the sign-in screen

notes.en: The sign-in screen is a dark room with a lamp: pull or drag the cord (or type, or submit) to light the room and the card. Motion is spring physics on one animation loop that sleeps when settled, and it respects reduced motion.
Logging time to an existing task takes the client, system, project and department from the task, so an internal task no longer lands under the first client in the list.
Editing a project task can move it to another project or unlink it; only a new task created from a project is pinned to it.
A Project & Finance stage that is current but still undated shows a dashed dot.
The task grid's natural-size column is wider.

title.en: Download the filtered documents as a ZIP

notes.en: A "Download ZIP" menu above the list saves what the current filters and search show, one folder per item: the latest version of each document, or every version with older ones in an "older versions" subfolder. The renderer sends attachment ids only; the main process resolves and owner-checks each file. Missing files are skipped and counted. Also gives the documents in an item's panel more room.

title.en: Export a daily timesheet range as one ZIP

notes.en: The Daily Timesheet card takes an optional To date. With a range it skips the preview and saves one PDF per day, empty days included, into a single ZIP (up to 65 days). Each report goes to the main process in its own call, since every report embeds the print font and a whole range would exceed the IPC size cap.

title.en: Quick edits, deletable settings and a two-group sidebar

notes.en: Timesheet
A session's time type and natural change in place from a small menu, the same anchored menu the status badge uses. It opens from the reading-side edge, stays inside the window and closes on Escape.
New-task form: Project and Sources are always visible instead of sitting under a collapsed "More options" block, with the form's normal row spacing.
Settings

A catalog entry nothing uses can be deleted for good. The bin is greyed out while any record or setting references the entry; the delete is queued in the draft, undoable until Save, re-checked on save and written to the catalog history.
Usage is read from the schema's foreign keys plus the text columns and settings that store a lookup code.
Hide/re-enable uses an eye icon and hidden rows are dimmed.
The tab list scrolls when it is taller than the window.
Clients
A client is shown by its name in the current language everywhere; the business code appears only on the client's own profile.
Address, port, username, host, URL and company code on a record card copy on click.
Navigation
The sidebar is grouped into Internal and External, with Overview, Today and Reports above both.
Project & Finance
The Excel export is named "Offers and CRs dd-MM-yyyy".

title.en: Redesign task cards and the task detail popup

notes.en: Timesheet
Card title reads company > system > project > task name, each lead-in part a link, replacing the separate pills.
Card totals and actions sit at the end edge so they line up down the page.
Remove the flat view, Repeat Last and the status filter chips.
One control height for the top bar and filter bar.
Task detail popup
Wider, with the sessions table in the same card and column order as the Timesheet.
Stat cards show sessions, work time and over time as hours with the minutes beneath; the combined total is dropped.
History, merge and edit-sources are small outlined buttons.
Created date uses YYYY-MM-DD like the sessions table.
Right-to-left
Table headers, top-bar actions, stat-card stripes and kbd hints follow the reading direction instead of being pinned to the left.

title.en: Search tasks by any source ref or url

notes.en: The task search bars and the task pickers matched only source refs, and mostly only the first one. A Jira source is url-only, so its issue key never matched. The search text now carries every source's ref and url, so an issue key, a full url, or part of an email subject finds the task.
Covers the Client Tasks and Internal Tasks search bars, the link-to-project list, and the shared task picker used by Add Record, session edit and merge.
